It's finally here, the Department of the Year award.
终于得到了，今年的最优秀部门奖。
dataList.place:
Hohenheim's Laboratory, Past
过去，霍恩海姆的研究室

dataList.content:
Indeed, I have finally done it.
对，我终于做到了。

With some minor assistance from you, of course. And… some other employees…
当然，你的协助也派上了些用处。以及……其他员工们也是……

C’mon. Admit it. Don’t ya notice that a lot more employees are saying hello, good morning, and what have you to you in the hallways compared to when your reputation was a bit… y’know? It’s all because I’m just that good of a right-hand man.
你就承认吧。虽然公司内对你的评价有点微妙，但是最近对你打招呼的员工确实变多了吧。这也是我这“右臂”尽职尽责的功劳呢。

I… will admit that your intuitive and spontaneous eye was of… some assistance when it came to identifying certain observations among Abnormalities.
确实……观察异想体的时候你靠直觉唐突提出的观点……的确有用。
This is the ‘potentiality’ I was talking about, man! 这正是可能性啊。

The same thing you saw in me when you decided to get me on board.
就是你录取我时看到的那个。

<color=#ffffa1>Apologies for ruining the moment, but…</color>
<color=#ffffa1>很抱歉在这和平的气氛里泼冷水……</color>

<color=#ffffa1>The next few years quickly and busily flew by without much trouble.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>在那之后的几年间都无事发生，时光便匆匆流逝了。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Of course, we picked up ourselves a few more ‘Department of the Year’ awards, some promotions, and some collaborative researches.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>随着数次的最优秀部门奖、晋升与共同研究，一起流逝了。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Yet all things must come to an end.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>而万事有为应有尽。</color>
dataList.place:
Lobotomy Corp. Branch, Past?
过去，脑叶公司支部？

dataList.content:
<color=#ffffa1>The infamous fall of Lobotomy Corporation, for one.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>人尽皆知的脑叶公司的结局。</color>

You… …ft us…
你……我们……

<color=#ffffa1>So, I don’t suppose you have any trouble hazarding what they're all telling me, even as the words come out fragmented.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>所以，这些人到底在向我叫喊什么……不用听都知道。</color>

You… …left… us…
你……把我们……

<color=#ffffa1>Nothing but words of endless resentment.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>那只能是无穷无尽的怨言。</color>

You… left us… behind…
你……把我们……抛弃了……

The fall of the former L Corp…
旧L公司的终结……

... I remember what Miss Yuri told us.
是尤莉小姐……以前说过的。

The site crumbled in an instant, trapping the employees in there with the Abnormalities…
支部在瞬间崩溃，员工们和异想体一起被关在里面……

What… what is this sound?
怎么了……那是什么声音？

The whole structure is quaking. What the hell is...
支部在摇晃。为什么……

[COUNTING DOWN. 95… 94…]
[倒数开始。95……94……]

The escape pods to the surface are here, but there’s only one seat left. They're saying that the next one's in… five minutes.
据说有向地上的逃生舱来了，只有一个空位，下一次装置……要到5分钟后才会来。

I-I…
我……我……

Listen closely.
听好了。
dataList.place:
Lobotomy Corp. Branch, Past?
过去，脑叶公司支部？

dataList.content:
At the risk of sounding rather callous, I must inform you that the chance of survival in cases of crises such as this is usually granted only to a very small minority of those affected.
你也许会觉得很绝情，但是通常来说能够在这种灾害中幸存的情况是极少数。

Some, who prioritize the fairness of the process may settle on primitive methods such as drawing lots to see who gets to escape…
如果只考虑公平性的话，也许还有人会选择抽签之类的原始方法……

And in more barbaric groups, the survivor would be decided by none other than the rule of might.
如果在野蛮人聚集的场所，或许会通过力量这一逻辑来决定幸存者吧。

However, I am glad to find myself among those who are on the side of intelligence. So I make this argument, a suggestion before you.
幸运的是，这个部门里全是聪明人，所以我有一个提议。

Compare yourselves, whose sole, final purpose in life is clinging to your mediocre office jobs and making good on your debt payments…
是像各位一样一无是处，无奈奔波于三流公司、又只得将偿清负债作为人生目标的家伙们……

... and me, who has produced several groundbreaking, epochal theses and research results at such an early age.
还是越随年岁渐长，越能产出杰出论文及研究成果的我……

Whose life, in your eyes, is of greater worth?
谁才更具价值？

<color=#ffffa1>Yes, and that is how this tale ends.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>对，这就是结局。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>The compound collapsed ninety seconds later. I left the employees of my department behind and boarded the escape pod elevator, and survived.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>90秒后支部崩塌，而我丢下了部门的员工们独自一人搭乘逃生电梯幸存了下来。</color>

How… how could you…? Without even a hint of remorse…?
你为什么能那么……淡然地……

<color=#ffffa1>Wrath is a hideous emotion.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>愤怒只不过是种丑陋的感情。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>I am here today only because I have always maintained a cold, rational head.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>正因为我总能冷静理智地生活，才得以站在如今的位置。</color>

The L Corp. Branch within Hohenheim’s Dungeon of the Fathoms begins to crumble.
霍恩海姆的心象迷宫中的支部开始崩溃瓦解。

It almost appeared as though his heart was crumbling as well.
在我看来，那就像是他的心也在崩溃一样。

<color=#ffffa1>Well, now that's over with... I invite you to come face me, the Distortion.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>来，现在来见成为扭曲的我吧。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>And the experiment will come to an end.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>那样一来实验才会结束。</color>

<But… just finding and defeating his Distortion in a fight…>
<如果就这么打倒了成为扭曲的他……>

<... I don’t think that’ll bring him back. I just know it.>
<他也不能回归原样。我有这种预感。>

I… agree.
我也……赞同。

We're still in deep waters here… this can't possibly be all there is to it.
直觉告诉我……我们还没能看见全部……
